text: Ethics in AI is becoming an important topic as artificial intelligence plays a bigger role in our daily lives. One major concern is bias, because AI systems can learn unfair patterns from the data they are trained on. This can lead to unfair treatment of certain groups of people. Fairness means making sure AI decisions do not discriminate against anyone. Privacy is also a serious issue, since AI often collects and analyses personal information. In addition, transparency matters: people should understand how AI makes decisions, especially when those decisions affect them. Responsible AI development means designing technology that respects human rights and serves society in a safe and honest way.
